source: adṛṣṭa pūrvam hṛṣitaḥ asmi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitam manaḥ me tat eva me darśaya deva rūpam prasīda deva īśa jagat nivāsa
candidate_a: After seeing this universal form, which I have never seen before, I am gladdened, but at the same time my mind is disturbed with fear. Therefore please bestow Your grace upon me and reveal again Your form as the Personality of Godhead, O Lord of lords, O abode of the universe.
candidate_b: After seeing this universal form, which I have never seen before, I am gladdened, but at the same time my mind is disturbed with fear. Therefore please bestow Your grace upon me and reveal again Your form as the Personality of Godhead, O Lord of lords, O abode of the universe.

source: kirīṭinam gadinam cakra hastam icchāmi tvām draṣṭum aham tathā eva tena eva rūpeṇa catuḥ bhujena sahasra bāho bhava viśva mūrte
candidate_a: O universal form, O thousand-armed Lord, I wish to see You in Your four-armed form, with helmeted head and with club, wheel, conch and lotus flower in Your hands. I long to see You in that form.
candidate_b: O universal form, O thousand-armed Lord, I wish to see You in Your four-armed form, with helmeted head and with club, wheel, conch and lotus flower in Your hands. I long to see You in that form.

source: śrī bhagavān uvāca mayā prasannena tava arjuna idam rūpam param darśitam ātma yogāt tejaḥ mayam viśvam anantam ādyam yat me tvat anyena na dṛṣṭa pūrvam
candidate_a: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Arjuna, happily have I shown you, by My internal potency, this supreme universal form within the material world. No one before you has ever seen this primal form, unlimited and full of glaring effulgence.
candidate_b: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Arjuna, happily have I shown you, by My internal potency, this supreme universal form within the material world. No one before you has ever seen this primal form, unlimited and full of glaring effulgence.

source: na veda yajña adhyayanaiḥ na dānaiḥ na ca kriyābhiḥ na tapobhiḥ ugraiḥ evam rūpaḥ śakyaḥ aham nṛ loke draṣṭum tvat anyena kuru pravīra
candidate_a: O best of the Kuru warriors, no one before you has ever seen this universal form of Mine, for neither by studying the Vedas, nor by performing sacrifices, nor by charity, nor by pious activities, nor by severe penances can I be seen in this form in the material world.
candidate_b: O best of the Kuru warriors, no one before you has ever seen this universal form of Mine, for neither by studying the Vedas, nor by performing sacrifices, nor by charity, nor by pious activities, nor by severe penances can I be seen in this form in the material world.

source: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍha bhāvaḥ dṛṣṭvā rūpam ghoram īdṛk mama idam vyapeta bhīḥ prīta manāḥ punaḥ tvam tat eva me rūpam idam prapaśya
candidate_a: You have been perturbed and bewildered by seeing this horrible feature of Mine. Now let it be finished. My devotee, be free again from all disturbances. With a peaceful mind you can now see the form you desire.
candidate_b: You have been perturbed and bewildered by seeing this horrible feature of Mine. Now let it be finished. My devotee, be free again from all disturbances. With a peaceful mind you can now see the form you desire.
